en: Black‑and‑white (slightly tinted) vintage postcard view of a riverside scene. On the left stands a large historic mill or industrial building with a castle‑like roofline and multiple small towers, directly by a weir on a calm river. On the right, a tree‑lined embankment stretches along the waterway. At the top, there is red printed German text indicating the place and viewpoint.
